basic_info.description: Welcome to 1831 Steiner. As you enter, you are greeted with soaring ceilings, natural light and warm wood tones. The front room is your second bedroom and can be a perfect flex space for a work from home lifestyle. Next, you'll enter the primary bedroom with en-suite and large walk-in closet. Adjacent to the primary bedroom is your second bathroom. The back of the home is completely open with the kitchen looking onto the living and dining area, which opens up to your outdoor oasis with large sliding glass doors, flooding the home with natural light. This home is a tranquil escape with its exclusive use deck and gorgeous backyard (also exclusive use) with an abundance of flowers, greenery and a healthy lemon tree that keeps out the wind and adds privacy. Other features include built-in speakers and beautiful sliding doors- giving the home a seamless and effortless flow. It also includes in-unit washer dryer hookups and a generously sized garage and storage room. This home truly checks all the boxes! Visit https://www.1831steiner.com/
